BrochureContent.Content:
Discover an exceptional residence that exudes luxury and elegance, nestled in the highly sought-after area of Kinsalebeg, Co. Waterford. Brian Gleeson Property is delighted to present this stunning four-bedroom home, where premium finishes and generous proportions combine to create a truly outstanding property.

This impressive home presents a unique opportunity for discerning buyers seeking a premium lifestyle just minutes from the picturesque Whiting Bay and only six minutes from Ferrypoint where you can launch a boat onto the River Blackwater.

Occupying an elevated site, this spacious detached residence enjoys beautiful surroundings and an abundance of natural light. The thoughtfully designed interior reflects the owners impeccable taste and commitment to quality with every detail carefully considered to create a home of exceptional comfort and style.

The property comprises an inviting entrance hall with a striking high ceiling and sweeping staircase setting the tone upon arrival. The dining room flows seamlessly into the modern kitchen, the true hub of the home. This expansive open-plan kitchen and dining area is ideal for day-to-day family living, featuring a central kitchen island and French doors leading to the rear garden, creating a wonderful indoor-outdoor feel during the summer months. The kitchen also benefits from a utility room, complete with an additional door providing rear access. A spacious living room features a stove for a cosy atmosphere, beautiful finishes and the added bonus of large windows and French doors, allowing natural light to flood the space. It is clear this home has been designed with light in mind. Another versatile room on the ground floor currently used as a home office, could also serve as a playroom or downstairs bedroom. A large bathroom completes the ground floor.

Upstairs, there are four generously proportioned bedrooms. Two of the bedrooms share a stylish Jack and Jill en-suite, while a third benefits from its own private en-suite bathroom. The impressive master suite is a true highlight of the home, flooded with natural light from dual-aspect windows. This luxurious retreat features a spacious walk-in wardrobe and an elegant en-suite bathroom. Resembling a high-end hotel suite, the master bedroom offers a wonderful sense of space and sophistication.

Perched on circa 0.49 acres, the exterior of this property has been thoughtfully designed and meticulously maintained with every aspect carefully considered to enhance outdoor living.

The rear garden enjoys a desirable South-Easterly orientation, creating a wonderful suntrap that can be enjoyed throughout the day. An expansive decking area provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing in the privacy of your surroundings. Mature gardens rise gently behind the property, adding to the sense of seclusion. A large fenced area, currently used for goats offers excellent versatility and could equally serve as a secure dog run or additional garden space.

The property also benefits from two garden sheds, providing excellent storage for watersports equipment, garden tools and outdoor essentials. The property also benefits from a built in car charger. To the front, a sweeping tarmacadam driveway and attractive walled entrance create an impressive approach, setting the tone for the quality and elegance that await inside.

Kinsalebeg National School is just a three-minute drive away and Clashmore National School within 3 miles, making it an ideal option for families considering a permanent move. For those drawn to the coast, the stunning beaches of Whiting Bay, Goat Island, Ballyquin and Ardmore are all within easy reach adding to the lifestyle appeal of this superbly located property.

Ideally located just off the N25, this property offers excellent connectivity while enjoying the tranquillity of its coastal setting. Youghal Town is just a 10-minute drive away providing access to a range of primary and secondary schools, shops, cafés and everyday amenities. The vibrant coastal town of Dungarvan is also within easy reach, approximately 20 minutes away offering an excellent selection of award wining restaurants, bars, boutiques and services.

Combining luxury living with exceptional convenience and access to some of the region's most beautiful coastline, this is a truly outstanding lifestyle property. 

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this remarkable home has to offer.

Contact Brian Gleeson Property to secure your private viewing.
